events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import re
rows=[]
for line in open('[REDACTED LOCAL PATH]'):
    if line.startswith('#'): continue
    f=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if f[0]"'!='"'chr9': continue
    anns=[]
    for x in f[7].split(';'):
        if x.startswith('ANN='): anns=x[4:].split(',')
    # get effects
    has_stop=False; genes=set(); annstr=''
    for a in anns:
        p=a.split('|')
        if len(p)>4 and p[1]=='stop_gained' and p[2]=='HIGH':
            has_stop=True; genes.add(p[3]); annstr=a
    if not has_stop: continue
    fmt=f[8].split(':'); val=f[9].split(':')
    d=dict(zip(fmt,val))
    info=dict(x.split('=',1) for x in f[7].split(';') if '=' in x)
    gt=d.get('GT'); dp=int(info.get('DP',0)); q=float(f[5]); ad=d.get('AD'); af=info.get('AF')
    rows.append((q,dp,f[1],f[3],f[4],gt,ad,af,','.join(sorted(genes)),annstr))
print('all stop chr9',len(rows))
# filter GT hom alt and reasonable depth
hom=[r for r in rows if r[5] in ('1/1','1|1') and r[1]>=5]
print('hom stop DP>=5',len(hom))
for r in sorted(hom, key=lambda x:(-x[0],-x[1])):
    print(r[:9])
PY"
